messages:
Alex: main turned red right after merge of PR #8423 — gpu-smoke failing in smoke-matrix on shard-3. logs show kvcache alloc OOM. paging @oncall and @maria
Maria: can you paste the failing log link?
Alex: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/12345/logs — snippet:
```
ERROR: kvcache: alloc failed at 0x7f...\nCUDA out of memory while allocating 512MB for KV cache
```
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0317-47. Notifying oncall.
Jun: I'm oncall, grabbing it. Did the PR touch batching or kvcache code?
Alex: small tweak to batching heuristics + a prefetch flag. PR description: "tune batch window for short requests"
Laura: can someone run `./scripts/run-smoke --shard 3 --env=staging`? want to see if it's deterministic
Alex: starting that now, will paste logs
Alex: local run shows same OOM — peak memory ~15.8GB on a 16GB node
Maria: maybe the new prefetch increases kv cache pressure. try capping kv cache 0.8 for a quick mitigation
Jun: let's rerun the pipeline job first before reverting. will queue rerun: `ci rerun 12345 --job gpu-smoke`
deploy-bot: Re-run queued by Jun for build 12345.
deploy-bot: Re-run started (args: none). ETA ~8m.
Alex: opening a bisect branch to test batcher change span
Laura: also prepare a revert PR just in case — faster to revert than hotfix deploy
Jun: re-run finished — deploy-bot reports PASS :thumbsup:
Maria: nice. Could be transient compaction. Still worth adding mem profile to the PR.
Alex: will add allocation counters and a regression test for shard distribution
Laura: filed INF-391 for follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-391
Jun: leaving monitoring on this for 1 hour, will re-open incident on recurrence
Alex: thanks y'all :rocket:
